description: A small open cardboard box sits on the desk in front, with a closed laptop beside it and scattered items like clothes, a paper cup, a snack wrapper, and a plastic bottle nearby. The left hand slides the box closer and steadies it as the right hand gathers the orange shirt and green cloth and drops them into the box, then adds the wrapper and the paper cup; finally, the right hand reaches back, picks up the plastic bottle, and places it into the box while the left hand keeps holding the box edge.
